Use the Write or Edit tool to modify files instead of an interactive editor.
Use `cat <file>` or the Read tool instead of a pager.
Use `<command> --help` or the Read tool instead of man.
Use `python -c '<code>'` or `python <script.py>` instead of the interactive REPL.
Use `node -e '<code>'` or `node <script.js>` instead of the interactive REPL.
Use `ruby -e '<code>'` or `ruby <script.rb>` instead of the interactive REPL.
Add `-e '<query>'` or provide a SQL file instead of the interactive client.
Use `git add .` or `git add <file>` instead of interactive staging.
Use `git rebase --no-edit <branch>` instead of interactive rebase.
Use `cat <file>` to read a file instead of reading from stdin.
Use `tail -n <lines> <file>` for a fixed number of lines instead of follow mode.
Use `ps aux`, `free -h`, or `vmstat` for one-shot system information.
Run the target command directly for one-shot output instead of using watch.
